# Dragoman Bahçe

> A Mediterranean garden bar in the heart of Kaş, Turkey — beer, cocktails, and snacks in a candlelit garden by the sea.

Dragoman Bahçe is a bar/pub located in Kaş, Antalya, Turkey. It serves beer, cocktails, wine, hot and cold drinks, and light bites in an outdoor garden setting near the Mediterranean coast.

## Key facts

- Name: Dragoman Bahçe
- Type: Bar / Pub (garden bar)
- Location: Kaş, Antalya, Turkey
- Coordinates: 36.1997208, 29.6419672
- Phone: +90 534 432 53 34
- Email: dragoman@bahcede.online
- Website: https://bahcede.online
- Languages: Turkish (default), English (/en/ prefix)

## Pages

- [Home](https://bahcede.online/): Overview, hero, highlights, and links to Google/Tripadvisor reviews.
- [Menu](https://bahcede.online/menu): Full menu — beers, cocktails, wines, hot/cold drinks, snacks.
- [Our Story](https://bahcede.online/hakkimizda): The story behind Dragoman Bahçe and its name.
- [Kaş Guide](https://bahcede.online/kasguide): Link to Kasguide.de, a guide to the Kaş area.
- [Dragoman Diving & Outdoor](https://bahcede.online/dragomando): Diving, kayaking, and trekking experiences in Kaş via Dragoman Diving and Outdoors.
- [Song Request](https://bahcede.online/sarki-oner): Guests can request songs to be played in the garden.

English versions of all pages are available at the same paths under `/en/` (e.g. https://bahcede.online/en/menu).
